items.description: todo-1 and todo-2 are coupled through apps/ui/src/shared/contracts.ts. Both add a renderer-to-main capability, and every such capability needs an entry in the IPC channel map and a method on the GeniroApi type, both declared in that one file. Two delegates editing it concurrently drop one channel or one method signature.

todo-1 and todo-2 are additionally coupled through the preload bridge and its main-process counterpart. preload/index.ts documents itself as the ONLY bridge between the sandboxed renderer and the privileged main process, so each capability must be added to the single api object there and to the ipcMain.handle table in apps/ui/src/main/ipc.ts. Both todos rewrite both files.

todo-1 and todo-3 are coupled through Chats.tsx. This 2,724-line component is the sole holder of a run's transcript state (`const [items, setItems] = useState<ChatItem[]>([])` at :176, fed into transcriptEntries at :1710 and rendered at :2303) and of the tail-follow scroll machinery at :805-:915. todo-1 must read that transcript to build the exported file and todo-3 replaces that same render loop and scroll effects, so both write this one file and the later write wins whole.

todo-2 and todo-3 are coupled through the same Chats.tsx. The project folder a 'Show in Finder' action acts on lives here — `const [folder, setFolder]` at :211, `const [recentFolders, setRecentFolders]` at :213, `chooseFolder` at :921, and the FolderSelect wiring at :2122-2123 — and folder-select.tsx is presentational, taking its callbacks as props and never calling window.geniro itself, so todo-2's handler and its new prop land in Chats.tsx. todo-3 rewrites that same file. Same-file writes collide regardless of which region of the file each todo edits.
